[deadpan, matter-of-fact, calm] You have never seen your own eyes move. Not even once.
[scoffs, confident, laughing] Bro, I'm looking at them right now. [focused, muttering] Left eye... right eye... [confused, slowly realising] wait... they just... TELEPORT?!
[calm, friendly, explaining simply] Your eyes jump about three times every second. And during every jump... your brain switches the picture off. So you don't see a blurry mess.
[horrified, gasps, whispering] So I'm blind... three times a second?!
[deadpan, unbothered, casual] Tiny bits of blind. Your brain fills in the gaps. You never notice.
[suspicious, low voice, narrowing eyes] Okay... what ELSE is my brain hiding from me?
[deadpan, casual, matter-of-fact] Your nose. It's in everything your eyes see. Your brain just edits it out.
[gasps] [whiny, annoyed, groaning] Ugh... now I can see my nose.
[deadpan, brisk, dry] Yeah. So can everyone watching this.
